title: Judge halts Trump policy that suspended issuing visas for 75 nations
shortDescription: U.S. district judge rules policy that the State Department announced in January was 'patently unlawful' and ran afoul of federal immigration law.

title: USPS issues rules to limit mail-in ballots if court order is lifted
shortDescription: USPS said it was issuing its 95-page rule so it could take immediate effect if a court lifts order blocking the changes from taking effect.

title: 'They all want that job': Trump teases Karoline Leavitt replacement
shortDescription: 'I have never had so many job applications in my life,' President Trump said of the list of candidates for the next White House press secretary.

title: 'Slap in the face': NAACP rips Trump over aircraft carrier name
shortDescription: Black community leaders spoke out against the U.S. Navy's reported internal discussions around naming an upcoming aircraft carrier after President Trump and not a Black WWII hero as originally planned.

title: 'OK with me.' Trump unconcerned if Republicans oppose data centers
shortDescription: President Trump said it's 'OK with me' if Republicans oppose data centers, which have been a bipartisan political flashpoint in many communities.

title: Trump says Leavitt made job 'glamorous'
shortDescription: When Karoline Leavitt signs off at the end of August, she will end her run as the second-longest-serving press secretary under Trump.

title: White House press secretaries who were working moms
shortDescription: These mothers ran the White House press room while raising families, balancing history-making roles with life at home.

title: Only 3 states still back Trump, poll suggests
shortDescription: A new YouGov/Economist projection shows Trump with negative net approval in 47 states and in D.C., with positive ratings remaining in just three states.

title: Trump plan to reduce beef prices faces pushback from some Republicans
shortDescription: President Trump announced plans to lower tariffs on imported ground beef, upsetting some of his own supporters in cattle ranching states.

title: Jill Biden: 'Who knows?' if Joe Biden was drugged in 2024 debate
shortDescription: Jill Biden revisits Joe Biden's infamous 2024 presidential debate, reacting to a drugging theory and revealing doctors ruled out a stroke that night.

title: Supreme Court keeps White House ballroom construction on track for now
shortDescription: Trump asked the Supreme Court to let construction continue on a $400 million White House ballroom. Lower courts said he needs congressional approval.

title: Paxton, Talarico trade criticism as Senate race heats up
shortDescription: The Texas Senate race is a toss-up as Republican Ken Paxton and Democrat James Talarico trade attacks on sports policy and animal welfare records.

title: Michael Cohen says he and Trump reconciled
shortDescription: Michael Cohen is now talking about “reconciliation” with President Donald Trump, saying the two men “forgave” each other ahead of a radio interview.

title: Kennedy Center lawsuit reignites to fight adding Trump’s name – twice
shortDescription: After the Kennedy Center board voted to add Trump's name back onto the facade, opponents again asked a judge to block the move.

title: Democrat's Senate map improves as Texas, Iowa shift to toss-up
shortDescription: A nonpartisan election forecast for control of the U.S. Senate moves away from Republicans in two states President Donald Trump won decisively in 2024

title: Texas Senate, governor races tighten as Cook Report shifts ratings
shortDescription: The Cook Political Report and Fox News now label the Texas Senate race a toss up amid tight polling numbers. The governor's race is tightening too.

title: Navy may name new carrier for Trump instead of WWII Hero, Doris Miller
shortDescription: The Navy may name a new aircraft carrier after President Donald Trump instead of World War II sailor Doris Miller.

title: Trump tries to push Darline Graham to victory with South Carolina trip
shortDescription: President Trump is visiting South Carolina on Friday to give a final boost to Sen. Darline Graham before the state's Republican primary runoff.

title: Navy may name new aircraft carrier after Trump and not WWII hero
shortDescription: The move to name an aircraft carrier after a sitting president would mark an unprecedented move. The carrier was expected to be named in honor of Doris Miller.

title: Debate grows over paid access to Trump's posts
shortDescription: Personal finance reporter Daniel de Visé examines the legal and ethical debate over Truth Social’s paid access to President Trump’s posts.
